_comment: Pinned price table for scripts/eval-runner.js cost estimates. Prices are USD per million tokens (MTok), standard tier: base input and output, no prompt caching, no Batch discount. Update by hand; never fetched at runtime. 'status' is 'sourced' when the value was copied from the cited page on as_of, and 'placeholder' when it is an assumption nobody has verified.
source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Model pricing table, 'Base input tokens' and 'Output tokens' columns)

claude-sonnet-5.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (footnote 3: the $2/$10 launch price is now the standard price)

claude-haiku-5-5.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (prompts up to 100,000 tokens; $0.50/$2.50 above that, which the estimator does not model)

estimates._comment: Heuristics used to turn eval specs into token counts. All values here are PLACEHOLDERS (unmeasured assumptions). Replace them with numbers from a real run's usage when you have one.
